Significant technological breakthroughs or disruptions, unexpected regulatory changes, or sudden shifts in public policy could also cause dramatic deviations. Furthermore, an unanticipated corporate event, if this forecast pertains to a specific entity, like a major scandal or a revolutionary product launch, could lead to an outcome far beyond my current statistical modeling of typical fluctuations.
